why: One of invoice.ts's two type errors is still there: lineTotal('3', 4.5) passes a string (squiggled, the status bar shows ⊗ 1). tsc emits JavaScript even with errors, so dist/invoice.js exists; the learner cleared the terminal after tsc's TS2345 and ran node dist/invoice.js, which prints a total because JS coerces '3'. The step wants invoice.ts to compile with no errors.

step.title: Fix the last type error and print the total
step.instructions: In src/invoice.ts, pass the quantity to lineTotal as a number (3, not '3'). Run npx tsc, then node dist/invoice.js. tsc should print nothing and the script prints the invoice total.

targets.caption: The quantity is a string here

hints: tsc still writes the .js file when there are type errors, unless noEmitOnError is on.
common_mistakes: Running the old dist/invoice.js without fixing every error tsc listed.
